verdict.rationale: LiveKit ships as a single binary, Docker image, or Kubernetes deployment, with a `livekit-server --dev` mode. Its CLI can access server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents, all of which support headless, scriptable operation. However, nothing documents CI pipeline usage, non-interactive flags, or CI-based automation. missing for 10: documented CI integration or examples, non-interactive/headless CLI auth guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
